hero.badge: Open Beta is Live — Join Thousands of Roblox Builders
hero.headline: Game-ready assets, built through play
hero.subheadline: Nilo is the fastest way to generate, customize, animate and export 3D assets for Roblox, without touching Blender.

features.section_title: Everything you need to build faster
features.section_desc: From first sketch to fully animated export — Nilo handles the heavy lifting so you stay in creative flow.
features.craft_desc: Generate objects from a sketch, image, text prompt, or all three. Refine the details, then drag into your world.
features.animate_desc: Optimize your polycount with the level of detail slider, rig with a single click, and generate animations with a text prompt.
features.packs_desc: Build the perfect asset pack for your game from a single image. Select which parts to generate and Nilo fills the rest.
features.avatars_desc: Generate custom Roblox skins with AI and create character animations with a simple text prompt.
features.playtest_desc: Preview your assets in your Nilo World, and invite friends to build and play with you just by sharing a link.
features.export_desc: Export models and skins with a single click, then upload directly to Roblox Studio to see them in action.

how_it_works.section_title: From idea to export in minutes
how_it_works.section_desc: No 3D experience required. Nilo guides you through every step of the creation process.
how_it_works.step1_desc: Type a text prompt, upload a sketch, or drop in a reference image. Nilo understands your creative vision.
how_it_works.step2_desc: Our AI engine builds a 3D model from your input. Preview it in the interactive canvas and adjust details freely.
how_it_works.step3_desc: Apply a game-ready rig with a single click. Add animations by describing the movement in plain language.
how_it_works.step4_desc: One-click export sends your optimized asset directly to Roblox Studio. No manual file conversion needed.

pricing.section_title: Build for free, scale with your game
pricing.section_desc: Get started at no cost. Upgrade when you need more power and exports.
pricing.free_desc: Perfect for hobbyists and first-time Roblox creators.
pricing.creator_desc: For active Roblox builders who publish regularly.
pricing.studio_desc: For professional game studios and development teams.

testimonials.section_title: Builders who use Nilo every day
testimonials.quote_him: I went from zero 3D experience to publishing my first Roblox game in two weeks. Nilo made what seemed impossible actually fun.
testimonials.quote_eternality: The animation prompt feature is genuinely magic. I describe a movement in plain English and it just works. Saves me hours every session.
testimonials.handle_eternality: Creator of Fire Elemental & Ice Hammer
testimonials.quote_dabeezneez: My whole team switched to Nilo for prototyping. Asset packs that used to take days now take an afternoon. Game-changing for our workflow.

cta.headline: Start building your world today
cta.desc: Join thousands of Roblox creators already using Nilo to bring their game ideas to life — no Blender required.
